# Daily Briefing — Sunday 2 August 2026

Yesterday was a massive effort — 31km in 3 hours with a 147bpm average HR. That's serious mileage, and with nearly 5,000 calories burned against a 2,300 target, you ran a significant deficit. Your body worked hard.

The good news is your recovery markers look solid. HRV at 116ms sits right at the top of your 100–118ms baseline, resting HR is an impressive 43bpm, and stress is low at 37/100. Your body handled that load well. That said, after 31km yesterday, keep today easy — a genuine recovery run or rest. Don't let the good numbers tempt you into pushing again.

On nutrition, today's priority is closing that calorie gap. Aim above your usual 2,300 kcal — think 2,800+ — and front-load carbohydrates to replenish glycogen. Hit your 175g protein minimum to support muscle repair. You've earned the food today!
